summary: The commenter urges the FCC to preserve the E‑Rate program, opposing any proposal to reduce, limit, or sunset it, arguing that doing so would deepen inequities and deny students essential broadband access.

claims.requested_action: reject proposal to reduce, limit, or sunset E‑Rate
claims.argument: Preserving E‑Rate ensures equitable broadband access for all students, preventing deepening of educational inequities.
claims.evidence_quote: ission to reject any proposal that would reduce, limit, or sunset E-Rate funding and instead continue supporting this essential program and protect the access for the students who need it
